title: RAI Assistant QA Pair
description: Canonical schema for one frequently-asked-question + answer pair used to fine-tune the RAI assistant chat model and to evaluate assistant behavior. Dataset lives in rai-faq.jsonl (one object per line).

id.description: Stable identifier, faq-001 .. faq-999. Never reused after deletion.

category.description: product = what the app is/does; project = the demo projects (Solar Alpha, Parcel A, Parcel B); domain = solar due-diligence knowledge; trust = caveats/limitations; howto = using the app; redirect = off-topic/adversarial handling.

type.description: Shape of the expected answer. redirect answers must decline and steer back to diligence scope.

question.description: Natural-language user question, written the way a real user would ask it.

answer.description: 2-4 sentence answer for a ~0.6B chat model: plain language, no markdown, no lists, numbers only when grounded. Must not contain facts absent from the grounding source.

grounding.description: Provenance pointer the answer may rely on, e.g. 'report:solar-alpha', 'research:solar-alpha-component-research.md', 'contract:scoring'. Answers must stay within the grounding; anything else is a hallucination failure.

tags.description: Free-form retrieval tags (pillar names, statutes, project ids).
